meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查你本地的 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 安装，与最新源码对比，给出通过/警告/失败的诊断报告；每条结论都附有命令输出或文件证据。诊断期间不会改动你的安装、配置或仓库。
howto.when: 当你说出“LazyCodex”、“omo-codex”等关键词，或要求做健康检查、怀疑 Codex 安装有问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查 LazyCodex 安装是否正常。
Codex 更新后行为异常，帮我诊断。
say.note: Claude 会比较本地安装与最新源码，定位问题。

say.text: 对比我本地的 LazyCodex 和最新版本有何差异。
say.note: Claude 会检查版本和配置是否漂移。

howto.what_en: After installed, Claude will inspect your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation, compare it against the latest sources, and produce a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence for each verdict. It never mutates your install, config, or repos during diagnosis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "LazyCodex", "omo-codex", ask for a health check, or suspect a broken Codex installation after an update or config change.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex installation is healthy.
say_en.note: Claude runs diagnostics and outputs a PASS/WARN/FAIL report.

say_en.text: Codex behaves oddly after an update; diagnose it.
say_en.note: Claude compares local install with latest sources to locate the issue.

say_en.text: Compare my local LazyCodex with the latest version.
say_en.note: Claude checks version and config drift.
